expect.stdout:
Archive a task or its subtree

Usage: charliebot session archive [OPTIONS] <SESSION_ID>

Arguments:
  <SESSION_ID>  Task id

Options:
      --archive-non-child          Confirm the target is outside the caller's subtree; an agent needs it to archive such a task
      --result-file <RESULT_FILE>  Path to the archive request's JSON body (summary, result_refs, run_ids); required to archive the caller's own task, optional otherwise (the summary then defaults to "archived by <caller task id>")
      --request-id <REQUEST_ID>    Request id binding the archive (defaults to a fresh UUID)
  -h, --help                       Print help
